meta.title: GDY — Professional Protective Film Manufacturer | PET Surface Protection Solutions
meta.description: Shenzhen Guangdayuan Film Co., Ltd. (GDY) — 20+ years specializing in PET protective films: silicone, acrylic, PU, anti-static, high-temperature and high-clarity. Serving electronics, automotive, new energy, building materials, appliances and hardware in 40+ countries.

hero.title: Stable, Reliable Surface Protection
hero.subtitle: GDY is a professional manufacturer of PET protective films — silicone, acrylic, PU, anti-static, high-temperature and high-clarity — with full customization and fast delivery to Southeast Asia and 40+ countries worldwide.

services.title: Six Core Product Lines
services.subtitle: One-stop PET surface protection films — every parameter customizable to your application.

items.title: Silicone PET Protective Film
items.desc: Residue-free, low-adhesion and high cleanliness; stable from −40°C to 150°C. For phone/tablet screens, optical lenses and precision electronic components.

items.title: Acrylic PET Protective Film
items.desc: Strong adhesion from 5 to 1,500 g/in with ≥91% light transmission. For metal sheets, plastic parts and glass surfaces during processing and transport.

items.title: PU-Adhesive PET Protective Film
items.desc: Ultra-clean lamination produced in Class-1000 cleanrooms with zero residue. For optical films, display panels and precision semiconductor assemblies.

items.title: Anti-Static PET Protective Film
items.desc: Surface resistance 10⁸–10¹¹ Ω with ESD protection lasting 12+ months. For electronic components, PCB/FPC and semiconductor packaging.

items.title: High-Temperature PET Protective Film
items.desc: Withstands 200°C+ without falling off during spraying or electroplating. For automotive paint masking, plating protection and high-temperature processes.

items.title: High-Clarity PET Protective Film
items.desc: ≥95% light transmission with optical-grade flatness. For optical lenses, touch screens and high-gloss product surfaces.

advantages.title: Why Choose GDY
advantages.subtitle: 20 years focused on PET protective films — from R&D to your production line.

items.title: Joint R&D Lab with HIT
items.desc: Formulations customized to your application — adhesion, temperature resistance, ESD and more — with our Harbin Institute of Technology laboratory.

items.title: Imported Base Materials
items.desc: Base films from Japan's Toray and Toyobo ensure no yellowing and no embrittling over time.

items.title: Fully Customizable
items.desc: Thickness 25–300 μm, width up to 1,600 mm, adhesion 1–1,500 g/in; anti-static, UV-resistant, high-temperature and flame-retardant options.

items.title: Free Samples, OEM / ODM
items.desc: Free samples for testing; batch production after specification confirmation. Private-label and dedicated-spec development supported.

items.title: Fast Southeast Asia Delivery
items.desc: Regular logistics corridors to Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines — standard products ship within 7 days.

items.title: Global Export Experience
items.desc: Exported to 40+ countries with DDP and DDU trade terms supported.

about.title: About GDY
about.subtitle: A professional manufacturer in the protective film industry
about.lead: Shenzhen Guangdayuan Film Co., Ltd. — 20 years focused on the R&D and manufacturing of PET protective films, delivering stable and reliable surface protection solutions to customers worldwide.
about.missionText: To provide customers with stable and reliable surface protection solutions — the right film, the right adhesion, delivered on time.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted protective film partner for electronics, automotive and new-energy manufacturers across Asia and beyond.
paragraphs: Founded in 2004, GDY operates a 16,000 m² production base with Class-100,000 and Class-1,000 cleanrooms and three fully automatic coating lines — an annual capacity of 120 million m².
Base films from Japan's Toray and Toyobo, a joint R&D laboratory with Harbin Institute of Technology, and ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 certified systems keep our quality stable from batch to batch.
